info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Communications Engineering

subTitleDesc.sub_title: 人工智慧的相關網路介紹與應用
subTitleDesc.sub_describe: 介紹深度學習神經網路的原理，並且實際應用，協助同學產出期末AI專題。

description.describe_ch: 本課程將介紹人工智慧的理論與架構，並且透過程式設計實現人工智慧的相關技術與模型，讓同學們發揮創意產出人工智慧的相關應用。
description.describe_eh: This course will introduce the theory and structure of artificial intelligence. Implementing the related technologies and models of artificial intelligence through programming design will be conducted so that students can utilize their creativity to produce related applications of artificial intelligence.

targets.describe_ch: 生成對抗網路的認知與實現
targets.describe_en: Understand and implement the generative adversarial neural network (GAN)

targets.describe_ch: 強化式學習神經網路的應用
應用CNN、GAN、強化式學習神經網路開發系統
targets.describe_en: Apply CNN, GAN, and reinforcement learning deep-learning neural networks to implement systems

textBooks.tpb_book: C. Perez, Machine learning with Matlab. Supervised learning and regression, Independently Published, 2019.
textBooks.tpb_book_en: C. Perez, Machine learning with Matlab. Supervised learning and regression, Independently Published, 2019.

readings.tpc_book: Al-Malah, I. M. Kamal, Machine and Deep Learning Using MATLAB: Algorithms and Tools for Scientists and Engineers, Wiley, 2023.
readings.tpc_book_en: Al-Malah, I. M. Kamal, Machine and Deep Learning Using MATLAB: Algorithms and Tools for Scientists and Engineers, Wiley, 2023.

iSoftwares.soft_name:
1.Matlab 2024a(或更新版本)
2.Matlab arduino hardware support package

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 課程介紹、卷積神經網路(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN)原理與應用
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Course introduction, installation and construction of Matlab development environment, establishment and training of deep learning neural network
Principles and applications of recognition using Viola-Jones algorithm
Integrated application of Viola-Jones algorithm and CNN

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: Regions CNN、Fast R-CNN、Faster R-CNN 神經網路原理與實現
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Principle and implementation of YOLO neural network
Integrated application of YOLO neural network and transfer learning for object recognition

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 期中報告、報告之解析與討論
LSTM RNN 的實現、RNN 的信號預測實現

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
所有學生應遵守以下通訊規定：
1.教學與學習以o365信箱作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
2.與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
3.您的電子郵件要署名，我不會回覆“匿名”信件。
4.自己要檢查信件文字的拼寫、語法和標點，我不會回覆您寫得電子郵件好不好喔~
5.週一至週五期間，若有提問課程學習問題者，我將在24小時內回復電子郵件。如果您只是將信息傳給我（如“我將在本星期五缺席。”），我不會回信給你喔~~
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Classrooms Protocol
Diversity and Inclusion
All course activities will be carried out in an atmosphere of friendly participation and interaction among students, respecting and appreciating each student's personal experience, background and perspectives, such as various school systems at home and abroad, diverse enrollment and learning cultures, gender, etc. You are expected to apply the highest academic standards throughout this course and to treat fellow students with dignity and respect.
Expected classroom behavior
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be achieved by maintaining mutual dignity and mutual respect among classmates, teachers or other lecturers. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by each other's classroom behavior rules, and get used to a culture of politeness.
Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. If you are sitting next to someone who might be chatting with you during class, move to another seat so you don't give in to temptation.
You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones and PDAs are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent.
Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
Dress neatly without revealing.
It is hoped that the content of the course rules will be described in a professional dialogue mode of the highest standard and mutual respect, with diversity and inclusiveness.
Teachers are able to guide students in ways, what students should do in the learning process, and their due responsibilities.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 請益時間的說明 在請益時間這個時段，我會在我的辦公室歡迎您，您也可以先預約。如果您有任何疑問或問題，請務必、盡快與我會面，以便我們一起妥善解決學習上的問題。也可以運用學校Office365電子郵件與我聯繫，但我不會在晚上和休假日回覆您。許多問題最好親自處理，所以鼓勵您運用請益時間直接來，與我討論。

在專題報告，觀察及審閱同學彼此的學習任務，鼓勵與同學合作，以完成書面報告、或專題實作。組成學習或閱讀小組可能是學習的有效途徑。但是，當您撰寫文章或論文時，文字必須是您自己的。用
  • 您必須認真遵守用於確認語詞和想法來源的標準規則。如果您使了短語或引語，或者是另一位作者的用語或想法，則必須確認這些用語或想法的來源，並在報告中標註這些素材的出處。作者的姓名和在句子末尾，包含使用原材料的頁碼。
  • 如果抄襲或以其他方式來掩蔽您的作品來源，您的作業將為零分。若屢次不改，將依學生獎懲辦法提送獎懲委員會處分。
  • 如果您作作業感到惶恐，請不要試圖作抄襲或作弊。可以與我聯繫，我們可以協商找出可幫助您完成學業的方案。一旦作弊，要協商任何問題都為時已晚。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
In the special report, observe and review the learning tasks of the students, and encourage cooperation with the students to complete the written report or the project practice. Forming study or reading groups can be an effective way to learn. However, when you write an article or thesis, the words must be your own.
  • You must carefully follow the standard rules for identifying the origin of words and ideas. If you use phrases or quotes, or another author's words or ideas, you must identify the source of those words or ideas and credit the source of the material in your report. Author's name and at the end of the sentence, include the page number where the source material was used.
  • If you plagiarize or otherwise obscure the origin of your work, your assignment will receive zero marks. If you do not make corrections repeatedly, you will be sent to the reward and punishment committee for punishment according to the student reward and punishment method.
  • If you feel intimidated by your homework, do not try to copy or cheat. You can contact me and we can discuss options to help you with your studies. Once cheating, it's too late to negotiate anything.
